frozen_before: any inventory or screening command of this phase
question: Is there, among assets already held on this machine, one executable policy task on which a working and a changed deployment can differ only in the bound normalizer statistics, with an observable task outcome, so that a prospective keep/replace decision can be adjudicated and confirmed?
population: assets already present on this machine at the phase start: installed Python environments and packages, model caches, dataset caches, sibling workspaces, retained evidence packets; nothing acquired during screening
roots: the Nisayon uv environment (uv.lock) and any conda/venv environments found under the roots
Docker images if a daemon is reachable without starting one

criteria_all_required.C1_checkpoint: a learned policy checkpoint's bytes are held locally with a recorded revision and digest, under a license that permits local execution
criteria_all_required.C2_executable: the policy's executable source revision is held (repository or installed package) and imports on this machine (darwin arm64) without new dependency bodies beyond the phase cap
criteria_all_required.C3_statistics_path: the policy's preprocessing reads normalization statistics through an inspectable path that can be bound to a statistics artifact whose bytes are held
criteria_all_required.C4_task: an executable task environment with an observable, measurable outcome runs on this machine without paid compute, hardware or a GPU requirement the machine cannot meet, within the temporary and artifact caps
criteria_all_required.C5_intervention: a working and a changed deployment can be constructed that differ only in the bound statistics, with model, task, controller, observations, execution settings and randomness held fixed
criteria_all_required.C6_custody: every required input is reproducible from retained bytes with digests; no reserved incident data
criteria_all_required.C7_authority: execution needs no authority beyond the existing one (no training, paid compute, hardware, reserved data, publication)

screening_order: inventory first; each candidate is scored on C1-C7 from evidence on disk; a candidate is rejected at the first failed criterion but every criterion is still recorded when cheaply observable
stopping_rule: stop when the roots are scanned and every candidate found is scored, or when the CPU budget is reached; if no candidate satisfies C1-C7 the result is an evidence-acquisition result naming the exact assets, sizes, sources, licenses, compute needs and cap conflicts for the best-scored candidate, with no incident manufactured and no toy substituted
non_authorities: a package name or repository name without executable bytes
a policy without a task outcome
a candidate the coordinator or either lane would prefer
exposure: the remedy class (keep the parent statistics versus replace with subset moments) is already known to both lanes from normalizer-execution-001; any study on a GR00T/LIBERO candidate is exposed, not a blinded repair discovery, and is labelled so
